title: The operator comparison pages offer the Space path, not only find a Circle

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: /vs/eventbrite and /vs/mighty-networks are read by people choosing a tool to run their community, but every primary button goes to /discover ('Find a Circle near you', frequency-compare.tsx:42,91,111,173). There is no way into Launch Your Business or a Space from the highest-intent operator pages. Fix: the operator CTA (OPERATOR_CTA_LABEL to the Space builder) as the primary, with /discover as the quiet link.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
